question: Who sworn in as a member of the Union Public Service Commission in September 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dinesh Dasa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dinesh Dasa** was sworn in as a member of the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** in **September 2023**.
 
• Dinesh Dasa is the former chairman of the Gujarat Public Service Commission (GPSC).
 
• He has a significant background in public service within the state of Gujarat.
 
• The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is responsible for conducting examinations for recruitment to various civil services of the Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bidyut Behari Swain**__

 __
 
• **Bidyut Behari Swain** is a retired IAS officer who has served as the **Secretary of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)**.
 
• He has also held various other positions in the central and state governments.
 
 
 
• **Suman Sharma**__
 
 
• **Suman Sharma** is known for her role as the **Managing Director of Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI)**.
 
• She has contributed significantly to the renewable energy sector in India.
 
 
 
• **Preeti Sudan:** 
 
 
• She is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1983 batch from the Andhra Pradesh cadre.
 
• Preeti Sudan has served in various capacities in the government, including as the Secretary of Health and Family Welfare.
